summary: Regression + new-feature test for DT app schema v2 (hull_number/unit_vin_number/drivetrain_layout, category_ids assignment, no truck_type/order/ev_only). Backend: rewrote pytest suite to new schema — 23/23 pass in ~6s (auth, trucks new fields + 422 on missing vin/hull, category_ids ignored in POST/PUT body, PUT /trucks/{id}/categories orders+drops invalid, GET /categories returns item_ids, PUT /categories/{id}/items moves items and clears/pulls from other cats, POST/PUT/DELETE /items auto-append/move/unassign/pull, DELETE category with items -> 400, checklist DT-001=37 (Chassis 29 + EV 8 in order) & DT-002=29, inspection stores truck_hull_number+truck_vin_number and drops truck_type, recap rows sorted by hull_number, matrix CSV header 'Hull Number,VIN,<dates>', summary CSV header includes Hull Number/VIN/Brand/Model/Drivetrain, uploads/download, dashboard). Frontend: /trucks columns Hull/VIN/Plate/Brand/Model/Drivetrain/Categories(numbered badges)/Status present; Add dialog has trucks-field-unit_vin_number/hull_number/drivetrain_layout (Radix Select with 4x2..8x8), no truck_type field; created TEST-UI-001, opened trucks-assign-<id> dialog, assigned 2 categories, reordered via trucks-down-<catId>, saved -> badges updated '1. EV Components / 2. Chassis Inspection', deleted truck cleanly. /categories: rows show 29 items/8 items; opened Chassis assign dialog (29 unassign btns), unassigned one -> count became 28, re-assigned + moved to top with up buttons -> 29 restored (verified via API pos1='Ban Kanan (Posisi 2)'). Dashboard recent + /inspections list show hull + VIN (MHRDT...) with no ICE/EV text. Recap page matrix row recap-row-DT-001 present, tab recap-tab-summary works, summary-row-DT-001 present. Driver /inspections/new: form-truck-select options render 'DT-001 · BYD Q3 EV' and 'DT-002 · Hino FM 260 JD'; DT-001 shows both Chassis Inspection + EV Components sections with progress '0/37 items checked' and VIN+drivetrain in header; DT-002 shows only Chassis Inspection with '0/29 items checked'. EN/ID toggle works (Dashboard -> Beranda, New Inspection -> Inspeksi Baru).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py register_master _update() forces category_id=None when body omits it (line 409-410); this makes 'PUT with no category_id unassigns' work as documented, but any admin editing an item via UI that omits category_id will silently unassign — verify the UI always sends the existing category_id when saving edits.

PUT /categories/{id}/items pulls ids from other categories BEFORE setting new category_id on items (lines 446-449), which is correct but not transactional; a mid-operation failure could leave items detached from all categories. Consider a bulk pipeline or session/tx.

GET /trucks sort is fixed to hull_number (register_master 'hull_number') — good. But sorts for /categories and /items are still by 'name'; if UI needs stable custom ordering, expose an 'order' or leave to explicit assignment.

checklist() only includes categories present in truck.category_ids; if a category is soft-inactive its items are skipped — but if all items of a category are inactive the category is silently dropped from groups (line 481-482). Consider still returning an empty group so admins notice.
seed.py resets dump_trucks/categories/items/inspections on SCHEMA_VERSION bump — safe here but destructive; document this.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Master form save button testid pattern is `<prefix>-save-btn` (not `-form-save`). Delete confirm dialog uses `<prefix>-delete-confirm`. AssignDialog testids: `<prefix>-assign-dialog`, `<prefix>-assign-<id>` (available list buttons AND the row trigger — disambiguate by scoping to the dialog), `<prefix>-unassign-<id>`, `<prefix>-up-<id>`, `<prefix>-down-<id>`, `<prefix>-assign-save`, `<prefix>-assign-cancel`. Radix Select options: `<trigger-testid>-opt-<value>`. Driver form truck options: `form-truck-opt-<hull_number>` (e.g., form-truck-opt-DT-001). InspectionFormPage does NOT emit `form-item-<id>` testids on cards — item counts must be inferred from the progress text ('0/29 items checked') or category section content, not selectors. Recap tabs: `recap-tab-matrix` / `recap-tab-summary`; rows: `recap-row-<hull>` and `summary-row-<hull>`.
